pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only an action

2. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

4. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.

5. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language School.

6. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.

7. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

8. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

9. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. run

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goed
   C. going
   D. goes

12. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

13. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

14. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

15. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
